description: Lists all connections accessible to the authenticated user (tenant-level, not workspace-scoped).
notes: Connections are tenant-level (no workspace prefix). Connectivity types: ShareableCloud, OnPremises, VirtualNetworkGateway, PersonalCloud. Credential types: Basic, OAuth2, Key, Anonymous, ServicePrincipal, WorkspaceIdentity. Use the connection ID when creating shortcuts or data sources. The connectionRecency object (createdDateTime, lastBoundDateTime, lastCredentialUsedDateTime) supports connection governance — a null lastBoundDateTime on a recently-created connection means it is not linked to any item. For scale governance use the derived commands: connection find-stale, find-duplicates, find-single-owner (see the connection-hygiene best-practice).
